original.description:
Big Yrame shifts her weight between hind and forelegs. She shakes a storm of rust dander from the tines of her great horns, and she blows a halo of freezing air from her rime-veined hands.
{{C|-----}}
Loved by {{C|the Fellowship of Wardens}}.

Admired by {{C|the villagers of Joppa}} for defending their village.

Disliked by {{C|the villagers of Tuwan}} for disparaging a famous poet.

Disliked by {{C|trees}} for eating one of their young.

visual_family: Human-based mutant with upright upper body and horizontal four-legged lower trunk; not the ordinary bipedal visual template.

source_facts.mutation_level: MultipleLegs6 is a level, not six legs.
source_facts.joint_coordinates: Unknown; native slots are not anatomical render bones.

body_plan_decision.status: Authoring choice based on source silhouette and user-supplied alternatives
body_plan_decision.reason: Compact sheep-like lower mass and ram-horn reading fit the source better than an elongated equine tail/body.
body_plan_decision.uncertain: Exact lower-body species, fleece, hoof anatomy and hidden joint positions are not established by native prose or slots.
body_plan_decision.direction: Keep the user-created centauroid attachments; reduce giant wool clumps to restrained map-readable fleece. Horns remain separate.
body_plan_decision.tail: Supplied alternatives add a tail. No Tail part, tail mutation or descriptive tail is captured; omit the unconfirmed tail in selected body art.

palette.neutral: Grayscale albedo with independent palette ownership.
palette.authored_mapping: Upper torso/arms/head use w; predominantly blue lower source silhouette maps lower trunk/legs to B. This is render-region ownership, not a claim of permanent biological coat color. Head cosmetics remain outside this pass.
